data.long_meaning: Goddess Sharwomani is a divine female deity who represents strength and power. She is believed to protect and empower women. Her name can be broken down to 'Shar' meaning strength and 'womani' meaning woman. The name Sharwomani carries the meaning “Goddess of Strength” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sharwomani usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
